en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1360 - Archangel Jibril (as) descended upon the Prophet (sw) and said to him:
"O’ Muhammad, live as long as you wish, for you will surely die; love whomever you wish, for you will be separated from them; and do whatever you wish, for you will be recompensed for it.
The honor of a believer lies in their night prayer, and their dignity is in refraining from harming people”.
